description:
Connect ChatGPT to your marketing stack with Two Minute Reports. Analyze PPC, SEO, social media, ecommerce, email marketing, and analytics data from Google Ads, Facebook Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Ads, Apple Search Ads, Amazon Ads, Pinterest Ads, Reddit Ads, Snapchat Ads, Twitter Ads, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, Google My Business, PageSpeed Insights, Google Trends, Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon Seller Central, HubSpot, Klaviyo, Facebook Insights, Instagram Insights, LinkedIn Pages, and YouTube Analytics - all in one place.

Ask questions in natural language and instantly get insights on CTR, CPC, conversions, ROAS, ad spend, SEO performance, social media engagement, ecommerce revenue, and marketing performance across channels.

Built for marketing agencies, ecommerce brands, growth teams, and data analysts, it turns multi-platform marketing data into clear, actionable insights directly inside ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Analyze my PPC campaigns & identify wasted spend, winning campaigns, and optimization opportunities.
Audit my SEO performance to uncover traffic drops, keyword opportunities, and growth recommendations.
Analyze my Shopify performance to identify top products, revenue trends, and growth opportunities.
